part1.old:
## Main Story

A lemon tart with chopped pickles sounds like a joke—or at least a strange snack. But Lawson says an AI program suggested the pairing, and it became the starting point for a real convenience-store product.

The idea did not stay on a computer screen. Human product specialists made samples, tasted them, and adjusted the taste and appearance. Lawson then planned a sale of the finished product.

point_two_body.old: FamilyMart used AI differently: it used sales information to help make a sweet-potato canelé that might sell well. “Oimo no Canele — with Caramel Sauce” launched nationwide on September 22, 2026, as a limited-quantity product. Separately, FamilyMart’s AI Recommend Ordering began at 500 stores in late June 2025. It uses past sales, weather, nearby foot traffic, and calendar information to suggest products and order amounts. Staff can change the suggestions.
